meta.title: VEXTRUS — AI-native construction takeoff, cost database, estimation and bidding
meta.one-line: Reads 2D CAD and PDF drawings, produces quantities a professional can sign, prices them from Bangladesh Schedule-of-Rates data and custom books, and prepares the bid. Bangladesh first; built to travel.
meta.author: Founder, with Claude Fable 5 (founding session 2026-08-17)
meta.builder: The FOREMAN harness (foreman/docs/specs/foreman.spec.md) — Claude Fable 5 compiles this file into a build graph; Claude Opus 5 builds it. A human founder gates milestones.
meta.language: English only. Bangla is out of scope for this Bible; every user-facing string goes through one string table so a second language is an addition, never a rewrite (R-SPINE-060).

preamble.purpose: This document is the destination. It states, for the four core modules and their spine, every feature, every artifact, the stack, the frontend and its design system, the domain law that binds every number, how "done" is proven, and in what order it is built. A session that reads only this file can build the product.

how-to-read.rule: Every normative statement carries an id. Ids are permanent; a superseded requirement keeps its id and gains status="superseded" with a pointer.

Id families: R-<MODULE>-nnn requirements · L-<AREA>-nn domain law · J-nnn end-to-end journeys · S-<name> screens · A-<name> artifacts · M0…M10 milestones · B-nn binding rules from the autopsy · Q-nn quality bar checks · D-nn open decisions.
priority: must (the product is not this product without it) · should (expected of a serious product; built in the milestone named) · could (built if the milestone's budget allows; never blocks exit).

phase names the milestone in <delivery> where the requirement is first built to production quality; a milestone's <includes> lists exactly the ids first built there (extensions are named in its <goal>). A requirement is not "done" until its evidence exists (see <verification> §evidence).
Where a domain law and a requirement collide, the law wins and the requirement is amended by the founder, never silently narrowed by a builder.
Vocabulary is fixed in <glossary>. A builder that invents a synonym has made a defect.

preamble.bible-rule: This file is immutable to builders. A builder that discovers an ambiguity takes the most defensible reading, records an Interpretation (id I-nnn) in the harness ledger with the reading and the alternative rejected, and continues. A builder that discovers a contradiction stops that increment with a named reason. Only the founder amends this file, by dated <amendment> elements appended under <amendments>, never by editing a clause. Nothing beyond the modules named here is planned or built until every `must` requirement is green — the ERP that this product will one day anchor is prepared for by keeping this core small and its seams clean, never by building for it (B-08).
preamble.governing-sentence: A partial faulty estimate is more harmful than no estimate. Measure less, completely, and say so. Over-measurement is a hard block, never a disclosure. Every refusal carries a named reason; silence is the only condemned state. AI proposes; code resolves; a human disposes.

thesis.product: VEXTRUS turns a set of construction drawings into a signed bill of quantities, a priced estimate and a bid that can win — one traced chain: drawing → quantity → rate → estimate → bid. Every number on every document is one click from the drawing region it came from, carries how it was known (its basis), what it does not cover (its coverage), and which rules and rates priced it. It is a professional instrument first and an AI product second: the AI reads, proposes and explains; code computes; a named person signs.

who-buys.segment: Contractors and developers preparing tenders (Excel is the incumbent; RIB Candy is the only local muscle memory; no AI anywhere).
Quantity-surveying and cost-consulting practices measuring for clients, bound since 9 March 2026 by the RICS AI standard (named surveyor, dip samples, written refusal).
Real-estate developers pricing their own buildings with custom (market) rate books beside the government schedules.
Tier-2/3 firms running no software at all (Excel + WhatsApp + a trusted accountant) — greenfield adoption is the wedge.
Small builders and homeowners wanting an honest, priced estimate from a drawing (a simplified proposal document; same engine).

thesis.what-it-is-not: Not an ERP (yet). Not a BIM tool — say "model-derived", never BIM. Not a marketplace, not a scheduling or site tool, not a bookkeeping tool. No live customer may be claimed; "Edison" is a competitor and internal benchmark only, never demo content.
thesis.how-it-wins: Not by a feature nobody has, but by taking the best of every incumbent — Bluebeam's measurement tools and sets, PlanSwift/On-Screen Takeoff's conditions and assemblies, Countfire's learn-and-count, Togal's one-click rooms and "ask the drawings", CostX's live-linked workbooks and rate libraries, Candy's rate build-ups, STACK/Buildxact's item libraries and bid-day views, Autodesk's classification and packages, Ediphi's benchmarking — and presenting them in one coherent, fast, beautiful workspace with three things no one ships: a typed basis and coverage on every quantity, a certificate and dip sample that discharge a mandatory professional standard, and a structured, effective-dated Bangladesh Schedule of Rates joined to register quantities and to the e-GP price bracket. Design quality is a feature: the product must look and feel like the best software its users have ever touched.
thesis.pricing-posture: Priced on projects and value, never per seat. Global AI-takeoff envelope $175–299/user/month; Bangladesh is a learning market priced locally. Billing is out of scope for this Bible; plans and entitlements are one table (R-SPINE-070).

binding-rules.rule: The destination is written before the first line of code, completely, and it is this file. Charting more than five decisions without emitting buildable work is a defect.

Vertical slices, one at a time, each demoable in the browser and covered by an end-to-end journey before the next begins. Fundamentals customers touch (upload, view, measure, price, export) come before governance refinements.
Boring, mainstream, strongly typed, one app, one schema lane, zero codegen, verification in seconds, no cache that can lie.
Versioned and immutable lives in git; mutable and concurrent lives outside the working tree (the harness ledger); nothing in this repository runs Claude.
Every guardrail that matters is mechanical — a type, a lint rule with a fixture test that proves it fires, a CI check, a database constraint. Prose is not enforcement.

Never guess. An unaffirmed scale, an unmapped unit, a missing rate, a malformed geometry refuses or defers with a closed reason code. No silent defaults, no bounding-box fallbacks, no ×1 fallthroughs.
Decimal at the seam, `numeric` in the database, lakh/crore on every document; floats and Western grouping are lint errors.
The core stays small; future modules attach around the register through the seams named in <architecture>. Nothing is built for a hypothetical module.
Design is specified, not improvised: tokens, components, screens and interaction rules are in this file and are verified visually.
Every claim of progress is audited against a tool result: a screenshot, a passing journey, a green verify run. A model's word is not evidence.

differentiator.name: Trust as the product
differentiator.kill-sentence: "Every quantity in our tool is one click from the drawing region it came from, and our estimators QA every takeoff — what does a 'basis' label buy you that a click and a human check don't?"
differentiator.survives: A basis is a claim about recourse (measured is rechecked by re-measuring; transcribed by re-reading; interpreted has no second reading — benchmarks put transcription at 0.95 and symbol geometry at 0.40–0.55, a gap every vendor hides in one number); a coverage declaration names what was not measured with a cause, which a click cannot; refusal with a named reason is a mandatory RICS duty no product helps discharge. Nobody ships a typed basis, a coverage certificate, a blind dip sample or a closed refusal taxonomy.
differentiator.claim: Lead with it. Basis is checkable, never a confidence score; the certificate is a query over data the register holds, never prose.

differentiator.name: SoR-native cost intelligence
differentiator.kill-sentence: "Any estimator loads the PWD schedule into a Candy rate library in a week — and the government is about to publish a unified national schedule, so your database is a free download."
differentiator.survives: A Candy library is per-firm, unversioned, rate-only. Ours is effective-dated, edition-versioned ("SoR 2022" is three rate sets; embedded VAT moved 7.5%→10%), zoned per book (PWD four district-group columns; LGED A–D with C/D swapped), with rate analysis underneath and every item bound to a register quantity kind — plus reconstruction of the procuring entity's Official Cost Estimate and the PPR-2025 ceiling-and-threshold bracket, which nobody serves. A unified national schedule is one more dataset, zero code.
differentiator.claim: The join to the register and the bid bracket are the moat; data entry is not.

differentiator.name: Revision-stable quantity identity
differentiator.kill-sentence: "We've re-linked measurements across revisions since 2019 — load your dimensions on the new drawing, Best Match All, review the flagged groups."
differentiator.survives: Only the narrow claim: our identity key is domain-derived (project, discipline, level, element type, mark, ordinal), no coordinates, so the delta survives a re-origined, re-authored or scanned re-issue — the exact cases CostX, Countfire and Autodesk concede — and the delta propagates priced through estimate and bid.
differentiator.claim: Say "your revision three does not reset the bill", never "we re-link measurements". Built in M9, after the fundamentals.

differentiator.name: Craft
differentiator.kill-sentence: "It's just another takeoff tool with a dark theme."
differentiator.survives: Only if the workspace is measurably faster and clearer than Bluebeam/CostX for the daily loop (upload → measure → price → export), and every screen meets the design system in <frontend>. Craft is verified by visual review, performance budgets and journey timings, not asserted.
differentiator.claim: Design is a requirement with ids, not a finish.

section.name: The register and identity
section.law: The Quantity Register is the system of record for physical scope. No module may originate a quantity: every stage inherits a register object, enriches it, emits it; every figure on any document traces to a register row by reference (never prose). A unit conversion is not origination only because it carries its derivation (source value, source unit as written, canonical unit, factor, factor provenance); "convert of no input" is no output, never a zero.

(project, discipline, level, element type, mark, ordinal). No coordinates (five drawings of one building shared zero coincident vertices). No labels or mutable attributes: a level is referenced by surrogate id; its label, ordinal and height never enter a key; storey height, concrete grade, rebar spec are correctable attributes that participate in diffs, never in identity. The ordinal is frozen at first registration and inherited through pairing; a mark rename is an authored act, never detection.

Each quantity kind has exactly one authoritative discipline. A second measured sighting of the same physical scope inside one drawing-set revision is refused at the door (`DUPLICATE_IDENTITY`) and kept as unpriceable evidence in a separate table with no join from any bill (a status flag on the register table is one forgotten WHERE from over-measurement). No matcher merges sightings — a wrong merge silently deletes quantity. Discipline is drawing-scoped, machine-proposed, human-confirmed, fails closed: an unconfirmed drawing is not walked. Attributes have their own authority (a general-note sheet supplies fy/cover while measuring nothing); disagreement is declared, never resolved silently. A measured sighting landing where a level expansion already stands is a promotion (geometry basis DERIVED → MEASURED, row re-presents), not a refusal.

Every derived row key is content-derived with zero minted ids (no UUIDs, sequences or timestamps), so an identical re-derivation reproduces the identical key multiset. View key = view class + caption-anchor source key; placement key = view key + mark + world coordinates quantised to 0.1 drawing unit; instance row key = placement key + level surrogate id (lawful-null slot FOUNDATION | UNRESOLVED, scoped per view); bar row key = member key + role + diameter + sequence. One-hop carry: authoring a level moves an instance key exactly once (`@unregistered:<label>` → `<levelId>`); a one-to-many typical-range expansion retires the placeholder and first-registers all N. Every derived row also carries an order-normalised semantic (canonical JSON of its content including cited evidence source keys): unchanged semantic → human dispositions carry across a rebuild; changed → the row re-presents for disposition. The semantic invalidates; it never keys.

Rows of a mark family sort by a canonical content signature of authored inputs only (length, breadth, count as fixed-precision strings; correctable attributes excluded), keyed `mark#i` (singletons keep the bare mark), tie-broken by row id — so ordinals freeze and never move. Pairing runs over (prior set revision's live sightings × new set revision's sightings) per mark family, drawing-local first (exact placement key, then nearest unclaimed prior of the same view within the carry bound), then the same family from another drawing of the prior set. A re-sheeted member keeps identity and ordinal and re-presents because its cited evidence moved. Sorting is by code units (`compareCanonical`); `localeCompare` is a lint error.

A campaign pins a drawing-set revision: an immutable, unordered set of (drawing, drawing revision) pairs by surrogate id, content-addressed by the digest of its members in canonical order. The manifest is the citation list — every member is cited whether or not it produced a quantity. Mutation is advance, never drift: adding, removing or re-revving a member yields a new set revision; an in-flight campaign advances only by an authored re-pin act naming outgoing and incoming keys and stating before commit: rows whose evidence moved re-present; an added member may turn COMPLETE into PARTIAL_DECLARED; a signature on the outgoing set voids whole. A campaign never forks across set revisions.

law.name: What a campaign snapshots; staleness is a diff

section.law: A project pins a rule-set edition (forked platform → tenant → project at creation, in one transaction, so an unpinned project is unrepresentable). Campaign creation copies onto the campaign, immutably: the rule-set edition key, the work-item catalogue digest (over `bears`, canonically sorted (class, kind) pairs), and the level-stack digest (over (level id, ordinal); heights excluded). The freshness gate diffs snapshot against what is in force: diverged and unsigned ⇒ stale, which blocks signing (`PIN_STALE`) and never measuring, cleared only by an authored re-pin; diverged and signed ⇒ voids whole. Nothing is stored as a flag. Book edition and multiplier scheme are pricing instruments and bind to the issued priced bill, not to campaign creation: a campaign with no book measures normally and emits no priced line.

A signed campaign owes a re-issue where any line inside its signed boundary has re-presented since the signature (a query, never a flag). A signed bill is superseded, never silently invalidated; issued documents snapshot their attribution and disclosures citing act ids.

section.name: Basis, coverage, refusal, tolerance, certificate, sample, signature
section.law: Basis says where a number came from, ordered by recourse: MEASURED (drawing geometry; rechecked by re-measuring) › TRANSCRIBED (drawing text; re-read) › DERIVED (a named rule over a measured number; re-run the pinned rule id+version) › IMPORTED (an external artifact) › ENTERED (a human; a named act) › INTERPRETED (machine-vectorised from pixels; reproducible but no recourse — never relabelled MEASURED; a QS hand-tracing a scan also produces INTERPRETED) › DEFAULTED (config where the drawing was silent; nobody looked, nobody decided). Basis is carried per attribute with its role (quantity-determining, item-selecting or both, declared once per algebra); a line derives two roll-ups weakest-wins, never stored: quantityBasis (determining attributes + geometry) and selectionBasis (selecting attributes) — a wrong determining attribute is a wrong number; a wrong selecting attribute is the right number at the wrong rate (the measured 20.2× overcharge class). An expanded object's geometry on a level not drawn carries DERIVED under the expansion rule.

COMPLETE, or PARTIAL_DECLARED with every omitted component enumerated on the row; PARTIAL_UNDECLARED is unrepresentable. A row kept with no quantity (e.g. `STOREY_HEIGHT_UNSTATED`, `STOREY_HEIGHT_CONTESTED`) is PARTIAL_DECLARED, never COMPLETE. An attributed ingestion truncation makes COMPLETE unrepresentable on that cell's lines. Coverage's two denominators: within a line, the item description (Bangladesh has no method of measurement, so the description is the method); for absence, the scope register (L-QTY-05).

Always: quantityBasis and selectionBasis; coverage; provenance to a register row as a reference; the (drawing, view) read from; a non-empty set of affirmed calibration references (per measured attribute); the engine that read the drawing (VECTOR | RASTER, orthogonal to basis); the rule id + version where DERIVED; the vectoriser id + version + render DPI where INTERPRETED; the SI value at full precision (`numeric`), the human-auditable formula string with named variables (rendered from the same registry template the gate evaluates), the raw reading and unit beside the SI value, the mapping rule id + edition, and the work-item selection beside the machine's derivation (a human pick never erases the machine's answer). Attribution is two-level: one named responsible surveyor per issued bill; a per-line actor only where judgement entered (basis neither MEASURED nor INTERPRETED, coverage not COMPLETE, or a deferral), derived from the act log, never stamped.

law.name: Refusal — shape determined by the axes

section.law: A missing mandatory publishable attribute → hard block, nothing publishes (and the block discloses itself through the residue). Known scope, not measured → declared exclusion + queue item. Evidence absent or illegible → declared exclusion. The drawing was silent → never a silent default. Interpreted geometry uncorroborated → declared exclusion + queue item, never a line (an interpreted line reaches a bill only as AGREED). Over-measurement → hard block, never a disclosure: a disclosure lets a reader add; nothing lets a reader subtract. The over-measurement check is scope attribution, not magnitude — where the gate cannot establish that an object belongs to the class and drawing it measures under, it severs the object from bill reach. Missing item-selecting attribute → the quantity publishes unpriced; missing quantity-determining attribute → the row keeps, with no quantity; an inadmissible reading → hard block; a doubtful existence → hard block and sever. Reason codes are closed enums, never prose; the same taxonomy serves machine refusals and human deferrals; every member of every reason enum is exercised by name in a test or deferred by name (the refusal register, Q-07).

law.name: The scope register is a query, never a table

section.law: The residue's cell is (sighted class × kind borne × level sighted). Sighting is a union of EXISTS over three channels within the campaign's pinned manifest — register rows of the class, the stored partition's placements and member-type families, view membership from the layout inventory; `NOT EXISTS` is lint-banned inside the channel module and appears once, in the residue query; a recogniser's output type is `Sighting[]` with no `absent()` constructor. Two orthogonal axes over one borne grid: the measurement axis (measured, or unmeasured with cause NOT_ESTABLISHED (writerless fall-through) · INGESTION_TRUNCATED (attributed through the parent chain) · NOT_IN_PROJECT_SCOPE (human-only act) · NO_BEARER_SIGHTED (kind-grain: no sighted class bears it) · unborne (KIND_NOT_YET_SEEDED, declared)) and the bill axis (NOT_IN_THIS_BILL, human-only act). CASE arms in order, first wins: published lines exist → quantity-bearing; a human act in force whose evidence resolves → its cause; attributed truncation; fall-through NOT_ESTABLISHED. Contradiction needs no state: an act declaring absent over a cell now quantity-bearing is beaten by arm order and surfaces as a Part A declared disagreement, not on the certificate. `ENTITY_TYPE_UNHANDLED` never reaches a cell; unattributable losses print as a sheet-grain fidelity block, enumerated. A rail contributes a candidate absence by not offering, with a rail-local reason riding the queue item as evidence, never a cause.

±3% under, +0% over against a competent manual takeoff, per class, a class passing only if its components pass (no netting), only under COMPLETE coverage; a number cannot reconcile with the source it was copied from. Ground truth is row sums, never printed grand totals; an input may never be derived from the figure it is compared against; a self-disagreeing yardstick row prints ungated; every disagreement is our defect until outside evidence says otherwise; yardstick defect, basis difference and revision drift are unavailable as excuses for over-measurement. Validation is a ledger of observations keyed (engine, class, kind), each citing rule-set edition, method hash and converter version, outlived (never deleted) when an instrument leaves force; provenance closed: HAND_FROM_RENDER · HAND_FROM_AUTHORED_SOURCE · INDEPENDENT_HUMAN_TAKEOFF; a class is validated on one live passing observation; the over arm is a hard failure at build, an under miss records a failing observation. An unvalidated cell certifies under a named UNVALIDATED disclosure and pays with full Part A review; the raster engine never borrows the vector engine's validation.

One coverage statement computed at publish as a left join from the work-item catalogue to the residue on kind: a kind with borne cells that published nothing prints those cells with causes; a kind no sighted class bears prints one NO_BEARER_SIGHTED line; a sighted class bearing no kind prints in a class-grain appendix in full. Two separately titled statements — measurement boundary first and in full over the whole catalogue, then bill boundary — never a shared cause column. Prints enumerations, never cardinalities (no counts, no "nine of twelve", no percentage); no money on the measurement statement; no severity ordering (sort `compareCanonical` over (kind, class, level)); no empty-section suppression (a heading prints with a closed *none* code); never colour or a symbol alone; contiguous level runs collapse on the face (L6–L10) while the query stays per level; the sighting channel stays queryable and off the face. Names the instruments in force as enumerated fields: rule-set edition (string, digest, fork lineage), catalogue digest, calibration keys; the UNVALIDATED statement at (engine, class, kind); an actor statement per separated permission (measured by · sample administered by · blind figures entered by · review rows disposed by · signed by) computed from the act log, with a CONCENTRATION disclosure over the closed pairs REVIEW×SIGN, REVIEW×ADMINISTER_SAMPLE, MEASURE×ENTER_BLIND_FIGURE; the sheet-grain raster disclosure ("all geometry on these sheets is machine-interpreted…", vectoriser id, version, DPI) which is also the AI disclosure; the abandoned-draw and failure counts. A bill without its certificate is not a bill and cannot be emitted; they bind into one server-generated PDF and travel in every export channel. No grand total under incomplete coverage — a labelled measured-scope subtotal only; the bill's face carries no per-row marks; the amount-in-words sits on the certificate, replaced by a closed reason code where the bill is unpriced. Documents round the quantity before extension at a per-kind fixed precision (a rule-set parameter); the register keeps full precision; the over-measurement block reads the register value.

law.name: The two gates and the signed object

section.law: Coverage/boundary (enumerated, in full, founded outside the register) and reliability (the named surveyor's written decision informed by the dip sample). Generation refuses on unsigned only — never on bad, never on unknown; adverse verdicts print on the face. The signed object is boundary (both axes) + rule set in force + calibration in force; a signature voids whole when any of them moves — an authored rule that re-derives, a re-pin, a calibration key no longer in force for a view; an identical re-affirmation or an evidence upgrade at the same factor voids nothing. Signing is its own permission; the credential is captured write-once on the signature row; verdict RELIABLE | RELIABLE_WITH_QUALIFICATIONS | NOT_RELIABLE with mandatory prose.

Quantities are sampled; the boundary is enumerated. Part A — the directed review queue: every machine-enumerable suspect input at the entered-attribute grain — unvalidated (engine, class, kind, level) cells (one row per cell), declared disagreements (suspended attributes, contradicted scope acts, STOREY_HEIGHT_CONTESTED), ENTERED attributes (six storey heights are six rows, never bulk), contested authorities — checked in full, never sampled; a row is reviewed when a disposition cites the revision now in force; unreviewed rows refuse the signature; the census is bounded by Part A ≤ Part B, computed over the whole census at sign time, refusing `PART_A_EXCEEDS_SAMPLE` (remedies: fix the input or move the boundary; never truncate, never grow N). Part B — the blind sample: draw unit (register object × quantity kind), stratum (class × kind × level), N = quantity-bearing cells × 2 determined at publish, minimum one draw per cell, the remainder by a closed recorded basis MONEY (a book prices the cells) or UNIFORM, level picked uniformly before object; seed minted inside the draw's transaction beside the population digest and algorithm id, so replay recomputes the set; the drawn units materialise as rows. Blindness is a write ordering: the entered figure is write-once (`DRAW_ALREADY_ANSWERED`); reveal of the machine figure requires a committed entry (`BLIND_ENTRY_MISSING`); the certificate claims exactly that. Absence draws are a census over human-authored declarations (name the evidence or lose the cause). A failure condemns the error's reach (the transitive closure of rows derived from the failed input) not the draw's cell; under → fix, move the boundary or qualify; over → hard block, no qualification door. Draws are irrevocable; an abandoned draw is recorded with a closed cause and never replaced; the certificate prints abandoned and failure counts. The signature binds one-to-one to its sample; no clock- or volume-based re-sampling.

A queue row is (subject kind, subject ids, disjunct); one attribute entering through two disjuncts is two rows. Order is derived (disjunct enum order, then subject key by code units) and never authored. A row cannot be deferred (deferral is an instrument of the boundary: to remove a row, hold the cell out of the bill). The act is `DISPOSE_REVIEW_ROW` with outcome NO_EXCEPTION | EXCEPTION_TAKEN (the competing observation written in the same transaction), citing a closed per-disjunct tuple (entered attribute → observation revision; disagreement → contesting revisions; validation-absent → rule-set edition + method hash + converter version; contradicted scope act → the act id and revision; contested authority → empty until a book exists). A disposition may not dispose the row its own act created (`DISPOSITION_SELF_REVIEWED`) — the only entry in the closed list of forbidden (act, prior act) pairs. Bulk disposal is lawful only where one judgement covers subjects that share the fact judged; the disposition is a typed table row in the act's transaction, never JSON.

section.name: Acts, permissions, roles
section.law: Append-only, human-only. An act is a human write that changes what the machine would derive, plus any human act a signature relies on as evidence. Machine authorship needs no log — it is basis + rule id + pinned rule set, checkable rather than believable; model calls have their own ledger (L-AI-03). Recorded at the granularity performed (a confirm-all is one act with N subjects). Act row and state change commit in one transaction or neither, enforced at the act seam, which is the sole writer of the log and unimportable elsewhere. Before-images are rejected: a human never overwrites a machine value; they add a competing observation with its own basis and declared precedence — agreeing readings corroborate (and bump the edition), disagreeing readings suspend the fact pending re-affirmation. A deferral carries actor, timestamp, a closed cause shared with machine refusals, a scope reference and a note that is never itself the exclusion. Repudiation ("that is not a column") is human-only and moves the object to the no-join table.

Every act type is a pair `preview(input) → Consequence` and `commit(input, consequenceDigest)`; the Consequence is a typed value computed by the committing code path; a commit whose digest is not the one current state produces refuses `CONSEQUENCES_NOT_CARRIED`. The pairs form a total map over the act-type enum (a type without a rendering is a compile error). Bulk is offered, never assembled: the machine offers groups keyed on the fact judged (typed grouping key over a closed enum + resolved membership in the Consequence); a freeform multi-select does not exist.

A closed permission enum cuts on what an act moves: PIN_SET (PIN_DRAWING_SET, REPIN_DRAWING_SET) · AUTHOR_LEVEL_STACK (INSERT_LEVEL, REPUDIATE_LEVEL) · AUTHOR_PROJECT_FACT (AUTHOR_STOREY_HEIGHT and later project facts) · MEASURE (CONFIRM_DISCIPLINE, AFFIRM_SCALE, TRANSCRIBE_SHEET_NOTES, AUTHOR_TYPICAL_RANGE, CORROBORATE, REPUDIATE, RENAME_MARK, and manual measurement acts) · SET_BILL_BOUNDARY (HOLD_OUT_OF_BILL) · ADMINISTER_SAMPLE (DRAW_SAMPLE, ABANDON_DRAW) · ENTER_BLIND_FIGURE · REVIEW (DISPOSE_REVIEW_ROW) · SIGN · ADMINISTER_PROJECT (ASSIGN_PARTICIPANT_ROLE) — plus, for the book/estimate/bid modules, ADMINISTER_BOOK (activate an edition, author a rate library), PRICE (select items, apply markups, approve an estimate), BID (author bid strategy, issue bid documents). A total map act type → permission sits beside the total act map. Roles bundle permissions and are the only thing a human picks: MEASURER (MEASURE, AUTHOR_PROJECT_FACT, ENTER_BLIND_FIGURE) · REVIEWER (REVIEW) · LEAD (PIN_SET, AUTHOR_LEVEL_STACK, SET_BILL_BOUNDARY, ADMINISTER_SAMPLE, SIGN) · ESTIMATOR (PRICE) · BID_MANAGER (BID) · PRINCIPAL (all). No shipped role bundles two permissions the law holds apart. Participants attach to (project, user), append-only, mandatory; project creation inserts its creator as PRINCIPAL in the same transaction; the last PRINCIPAL cannot be removed (`PROJECT_WOULD_HAVE_NO_PRINCIPAL`); assignment is itself an act. Separation binds the subject, never the grant: no permission bars a person from holding another (a solo QS is a real customer); `PERMISSION_NOT_HELD` carries the act type and missing permission; concentration is disclosed on the certificate. Participation is a composite FK from the act log; the permission check lives in the act seam.

section.name: Measurement rules

law.name: Rules as data; parameter vs method

section.law: Parameters (thresholds, allowances, placement bands) are versioned data in an immutable rule-set edition keyed by a digest over its parameter values × the (rule id, version) pairs of methods in force; authoring mints a new edition, never updates one, and is its own permission. Methods (formulas, expansions, resolvers) are code, enumerated by (rule id, version), one file per method under a fixed directory, hashed whole into a committed manifest that a verify stage refuses to see drift; a comment edit forces a version bump, and a version bump moves every edition citing it. Seed rule set `IS1200_IN @ 2026.08` (the version string names India because Bangladesh has no measurement authority for these values): openingDeductionMinM2 0.1 · memberEndNoDeductMaxCm2 500 · embeddedDuctNoDeductMaxCm2 100 · finishOpeningDeductionMinM2 0.1 · finishMinOutlineArea 0.2 sft / finishMaxOutlineArea 20,000 sft (out-of-band outlines dropped listed, never silently) · scaleVerificationTolerance 0.01 · scaleAnisotropyTolerance 0.01 · earthworkWorkingAllowance 1.5 ft · earthworkDepthExtra 0.5 ft · blindingProjection 3 in · blindingThickness 3 in · placement shares (containment/merge 0.08, near-anchor 0.9, footprint 0.6–2.5, human snap 0.5). Junction conventions carry citations and silence is never lawful: vertical members measure full storey height floor-to-floor; beam length is the drawn long-section span with the junction in the beam; slab–beam junction deductions defer with a reason. Rebar volume is never deducted from concrete (a method with no toggle).

The opening schedule is the authority; adjacency is a declared cross-check; a face with no schedule is not measured (gross area would over-measure). An opening deducts only if strictly greater than the threshold; below-threshold openings are ignored by rule and listed — deducted sum, ignored sum, counts and threshold in force land in the line's variables. Opening marks are scoped to their floor group; a schedule row claiming floors makes the expansion DERIVED, not TRANSCRIBED; header text is evidence to verify, not trust.

A surface that is not a closed outline defers with a reason — never bounding-boxed. `net = gross − Σ(deducted openings)` per surface group, every deducted opening citing its source entity; an opening seen but not areable is flagged; retained openings carry the rule that retained them.

A kind names a trade and material only (`kind = chapter × dimension, named for the trade`); never a dimension or unit (AREA, LENGTH, COUNT, WEIGHT, VOLUME, CUM, SQM, RFT, NR…), never an element class or member type, never a pricing role, never a book or chapter code — enforced by a token test over the kind names against the dimension set, unit abbreviations and ELEMENT_TYPES. The enum is code-owned and closed; the work-item catalogue (per kind: description, canonical SI unit and dimension, document rounding precision) and the `bears` relation (class × kind, what a class lawfully bears) are TS consts emitted as tables by migration with a drift stage; a class bearing no kind is declared in an unborne set. Kind → authoritative discipline and kind → algebra are two independent total maps. Added-rate items carry the base item's kind plus `isRateModifier` in the book, price as their own line beside the base item, and are filtered out of the coverage denominator. Mapping a line to a book item: trade first (kind → chapter), the dimension lock has the final veto, never dimension alone (a dimension-only matcher priced pile-cap excavation at the RCC casting rate); no confident trade ⇒ no selection, the line stays visibly unpriced; one table serves the automatic matcher and the learned dictionary.

Scale is established by affirmation acts, each naming the views it covers (a scale group is the subject set of one act; ~6–8 per project), the rank it stood on and the source keys under it. Membership is positive, never residual: a view no act names has no scale, is hatched, and measures nothing — declared, never silent (`SCALE_NO_EVIDENCE`; `SCALE_UNIT_UNMAPPED` when rank 4 carried an unmapped code). Precedence: QS two-point (each point cites a source key + world coordinate quantised to 0.1 unit; a free click refuses `SCALE_OBSERVATION_UNCITED`; the stated distance is ENTERED) › grid-spacing match › overridden dimension ratio (style factor divided out) › file units header. Printed scale notes are not evidence at any rank. X and Y derive independently and are averaged as nothing (anisotropy beyond tolerance makes the view unplaceable); a single-observation scale is verified at ±1% or rejected. Ranks 2–4 are recomputed from the frozen artifact, never stored. The calibration reference is a content-addressed key over (view key, factorX, factorY) as 12-place half-even decimal strings, carried per measured attribute with the affirming act id; a line stores a non-empty set (no COUNT exemption). Re-affirmation is an authored act naming outgoing and incoming keys and stating which lines re-derive and which signatures void. The gate multiplies, not the rail: offers carry drawing units + the view; the gate resolves calibration and evaluates in decimal, diagonals componentwise `hypot(dx·X, dy·Y)`, areas `X·Y`. A QS override is a declared disagreement enumerated in Part A. The strict unit lane: unknown or unmapped unit ⇒ null, never a guessed scale.

Store `clear height 6.2 m`, never `band: 3`; the pricing seam emits base + banded add-items inheriting one object. Defaults are barred from quantity-determining attributes (a citable clause is DERIVED, not DEFAULTED; a DEFAULTED selecting attribute names its convention on the certificate). SITE attributes — facts no drawing carries — are always ENTERED: lead (metres within site; kilometres off-site), lift, elapsedHours, operationOrdinal, formworkReuses, haulDistanceKm, project inaccessibleAreaCategory (PWD Ch. 33 A/B/C 5/10/15%). Consequence stated plainly on the face: earthwork is structurally unpriceable from drawings alone until SITE facts are entered.

A level is a project-scoped object with a surrogate id; label, ordinal and height are non-identifying; the ordinal is physical and the floor-multiplier scheme keys to it (a scheme with no row for an ordinal throws `LEVEL_ORDINAL_UNMAPPED`; a tenant with no scheme means no priced line may be emitted, no quantity affected). Inserting a level mid-stack re-keys nothing (ordinals above move; mark-family ordinals do not); a level with live rows is never deleted, only repudiated; an insert states its consequence (registers N objects across M classes). The stack is the vertical coverage denominator, pinned on the campaign as a digest. `storeyHeightFloorToFloor` (metres) is a set of readings keyed (level, actor, basis, evidence source key), each storing the value and unit as written beside canonical metres with factor and provenance; agreeing readings corroborate, disagreeing readings suspend (cleared only by re-affirmation, never precedence); TRANSCRIBED/DERIVED/ENTERED admitted, DEFAULTED barred; equality is on canonical metres. The act is `AUTHOR_STOREY_HEIGHT`, one row per reading, no lines — heights reach lines only through the gate. A level is authorable with no height; the line reports the consequence. Per-floor roll-ups sort by ordinal, never lexicographically.

Four algebras: member (section × run + bar rule; structure and brick walls), face (a face of a space, gross less scheduled openings), network (runs by diameter), topology (a tee is a junction in the run graph). Rail is selected per quantity kind, never per drawing; rails share only setup, the register and the document stage; MEP fittings derive, never count — MEP publishes runs only until fidelity is proven. A rail is a pure function returning `{ offers, observations }`: an offer carries geometry (the typed union of L-FRM-01, its own basis and calibration reference), `bindings` (the method's declared variables) and `selectors` (item-selecting attributes), each `{ value, unit, basis, source, calibration? }`, deduction candidates per channel with geometry/basis/source and no sums, the register-row reference, the (drawing, view), and a `ruleId` with no version; there is no field where a computed value could land. The gate — in core, unimportable from modules, the spine's sole writer of quantity lines — resolves the version from the project's pinned edition (`METHOD_NOT_IN_EDITION`, `METHOD_IMPLEMENTATION_MISSING`), normalises units in decimal (`UNIT_UNMAPPED`), reads deduction thresholds from the edition and partitions strictly-greater, evaluates and renders the formula from one template, and returns a total verdict `{ published, refused, queued }` summing to the offers, written with observation rows in one transaction; refusals are returned, never thrown; the refused arm is for contract violations only; malformed geometry is a non-offer reaching the residue as evidence. Observations carry a rail-local closed code keyed (class × kind) with optional object and source entity.

section.name: CAD and PDF ingestion

law.name: The seam is a format boundary; the CLI is one-shot

section.law: `cad/` turns file formats into one geometry vocabulary — the EntityGraph — and stops. It is invoked once per drawing revision, never fed app-produced input, never re-opened by the app; everything that reads meaning (schedule reconstruction, view law, grid, placement, convention profile, member-type registry, notation parsing) runs in TypeScript over the artifact. A stage in the app improves by a partition rebuild; the same stage in the CLI would be a declared re-ingest minting a new key multiset. Text crosses the seam raw (AutoCAD escapes `%%C`→Ø, `%%D`→°, `%%P`→± are stripped by the app's parsers).

Every original entity carries a source key `scheme:key`, the scheme closed and split by the extractor that minted it: `DXF_HANDLE` (ezdxf, DWG or DXF upload — the file's own handle), `PDF_OBJECT` (pdfium — a content digest), `RASTER_TRACE` (the vectoriser — a content digest). The scheme rides per key, never per drawing (one page may mint both). A key is scoped to (file bytes, extractor identity: version + parameter-set hash per scheme); the ingest record pins extractor identity. The content digest is over page index + object type + resolved page-space geometry quantised to 0.001 pt (half-even, fixed-precision string; text is geometry: decoded string + anchor + quantised height) — never a counter, byte offset or page label; colour, line width, dash, fill and font name are excluded; colliding objects collapse to one and the collapse is counted per page and type. A vectoriser is deterministic within a pinned identity (torture-corpus fixture: vectorise twice, identical multiset); it runs once per ingest and freezes; upgrading it is a declared re-ingest. Coordinates stay in native drawing units; `$INSUNITS` reported (0 unitless · 1 inch · 2 foot · 4 mm · 5 cm · 6 m); an unmapped code reports null + a flag, never unitless.

Derived paint geometry never reaches the extractor: INSERTs and PDF Form XObjects explode to world coordinates for rendering only, every synthesised entity carries `src` (its parent instance's key), extraction consumes original entities only; nested recursion under a depth cap and a derived-entity budget; a cap that trips says so (`explode_truncated` + per-type loss counters, per page). Block attributes collect separately; a dimension's measurement text is a derived text entity. The atom a source key names is one EntityGraph original entity, defined only by the extractor.

DWG → DXF via LibreDWG (GPL) in an isolated subprocess only, built `--enable-release`, two passes reconciled per entity type (`dwgread -O JSON` census + `dwg2dxf` geometry; the exit code is not a success signal; any per-type shortfall or `UNKNOWN_ENT` refuses that class on that sheet by name; an unparseable DXF refuses the sheet). ODA File Converter is banned. DXF via ezdxf (MIT). PDF via pypdfium2 (permissive); AGPL PDF libraries (PyMuPDF/fitz, mutool, `@vivliostyle/cli`) are banned in shipped code and a licence test enforces it on both runtimes. Raster (scans, images, raster PDFs) via a pinned classical-CV vectoriser (deterministic; ML only under deterministic kernels and a fixed seed). Stateless, temp-dir per invocation, loud failures, generous timeouts.

law.name: Rendering and geometry facts in the artifact

section.law: Colour resolved server-side (true colour → explicit → BYLAYER → BYBLOCK); text carries world height; robust extents with stray-entity rejection (bbox centre outside the 2nd–98th inter-percentile window +25%, the count recorded); paper layouts get their own bbox, content-less layouts dropped and counted; closed polylines carry shoelace area; curves flatten at fixed tolerance with a point cap whose trip is counted; a space marker per entity (model space or named layout); a layout inventory. EntityGraph is versioned (v2 as the floor) and mirrored in Zod; both sides parse committed fixtures.

Every model-space original entity belongs to exactly one view; view types are a closed branded vocabulary (layout plan · schedule · long-section strip · member section · detail · stair plan · stair section · legend/notes · title · untyped · unassigned) exported from one module beside the sole predicate, literals lint-banned elsewhere. Only layout-plan-class views may yield instances; schedules, sections and details yield types and dimensions only; member-scoped plans are details. Classification follows caption grammar, never title literals; an unclassifiable caption anchors nothing and the view is honestly untyped. Machine proposes; a human confirms.

Grid axes (letter/numeral families, per-view georeference) derive only from layout-plan evidence, filtered before detection, by content signature (a bare letter/numeral inside a circle), never layer names; a view without lawful bubble evidence georeferences as deferred. Placement constants are content-scaled shares of the minimum grid spacing (rule-set parameters, L-MEA-01); label normalisation compares dotless-uppercase; foundation classes take the lawful-null level basis; vertical classes (column, shear wall) expand per level at placement — a `TYPICAL FLOOR PLAN` sighting nine columns across six levels mints 54 instance rows — as an order-independent resolver over the whole set revision; a bare typical caption states no membership and registers UNRESOLVED rows with no line (`TYPICAL_RANGE_UNSTATED`); a stated range whose endpoint the stack lacks refuses `LEVEL_RANGE_ENDPOINT_UNMAPPED`. The partition is stored and rebuilt per ingest, never computed per read.

A drawing's conventions (which layers carry linework, outlines, text, dimensions; which caption grammars name views) resolve per drawing from an entity census by geometry statistics; a replaceable seed may corroborate but never add, drop or re-assign a role (`resolve(census, {})` deep-equals `resolve(census)`; CI-enforced); the resolver enters the edition as (rule id, version), the seed is pinned by nothing. Schedule tables reconstruct without gridlines: anchor on the title, row-cluster by y with band-first clustering, stop at a gap > 3.5× pitch, header row is the first leading row with a name/mark cell, columns from header centres, two texts in one cell join with `+`, every cell cites its source keys; a reconstructor returning zero tables on a schedule-titled sheet surfaces. The member-type registry: one row per mark family, variants beneath, rebar zones per band, raw cell text retained verbatim, noise never becomes a family, a schedule view contributing nothing surfaces a deferral, and nothing here emits a member count. Notation parsers (feet-inches, size pairs, rebar groups, spacing, floor zones, `N of` multipliers, Ø-lookalikes) are golden-tested against real strings and live in the app.

A sanity number after any converter change (a pinned reference drawing reads an exact known count of recovered + named losses; a silent lower or higher count fails). Fixtures are synthetic drawings authored by committed scripts, including a revision pair; competitor-derived drawings never enter the repository.

section.name: Bangladesh authority
section.law: No national SMM exists. Operative precedence: the contract; BPPA standard tender BOQ notes; the procuring agency's SoR item descriptions (which carry conventions inline); the Engineer's determination. The item description is the method of measurement; every quantity binds to the description that produced it. Opening-deduction thresholds are IS 1200 (Indian) convention — imported, labelled so, per-project config.

Quantities are computed net from the drawings (no bulking, shrinkage or waste allowance); payment is on actual measured quantities. Rebar payment is on nominal mass (`d²/162` with the verified kg/m lookup), never weighed; laps are billable bar-in-place and a first-class, separately attributable component (net-of-laps and gross-of-laps both showable); couplers and welded splices are separate items. BNBC 2020 Part 6 Ch. 8 determines lap length (Class A 1.0 ℓd / Class B 1.3 ℓd, floor 300 mm, Class B default; ≥36 mm bars cannot be lap-spliced; mixed diameters take the larger); a drawing's general note (`50d`) overrides the computed table verbatim and re-versions the applied rule set.

Standards of Weights and Measures Act 2018 §4(1), §67, §68: SI is the standard; non-standard units are barred on price documents, contracts and written measurement records. Store and compute SI, full precision; imperial is legal only as an input read off a sheet, retained as provenance; documents own presentation (sft/cft/rft where the market wants it, derived from SI at render), the register never does. §30: brochure area is binding on as-built (a sales-side exposure recorded, not ours yet).

Books: PWD SoR (33 chapters + annexures, dotted item codes `07 → 07.12 → 07.12.7`, front matter with labour/material/carriage rates and a district distance matrix; every rate quoted in four district-group columns — Dhaka/Mymensingh · Chattogram/Sylhet · Khulna/Barisal/Gopalgonj · Rajshahi/Rangpur — lettered A–D only in the original 2022 edition); LGED SoR (excludes PWD-common items and cross-references them; zones A–D with C/D swapped against PWD; books disagree substantively — scope rulings are book-scoped); RHD SoR (five zones); the imminent unified national schedule (one more dataset, zero code). "SoR 2022" is three rate sets (2022 · Revised eff. 2023-02-23 · 2nd Revised eff. 2026-01-22): a stored rate carries edition + effective date; rates are VAT-inclusive as printed and the embedded VAT moved 7.5%→10% between editions. A chapter reference is (book, chapter), never a bare code. The district→column map is an authored, cited dataset row per book edition with no published authority. Added-rate items (extra height per metre, extra floor, extra excavation depth per 0.5 m, Ch. 33 uplifts) modify a base item and bill as separate lines. A leaf-only sweep of a book is not a sweep (headings and rate tables hide items). What a PWD base item includes is quantity-bearing law: RCC measured on the gross concrete section, no deduction for reinforcement, formwork a separate item even where the concrete narrates shuttering; formwork in sqm of contact area priced by structural member (12 sub-items, height bands above 4 m, reuses); brickwork at nominal declared thickness (250/375 mm) in cum; excavation in cum banded by depth (per 0.5 m over 1.5 m) and lead (per 1 m over 10 m), dewatering per hour; plaster in sqm by thickness, mix, face and floor.

Every rate changes by Finance Act/Ordinance and mid-year SRO: model as effective-dated (code, category, payee type, fiscal year) tables; FY2025-26 seed sanity values only — standard VAT 15%; construction services (S004) 10%; procurement provider (S037) 7.5%; land developer 3%; flat sale 2%/4.5% by size; material VAT often specific per unit (bricks per thousand, MS per MT) so the engine supports percentage and per-unit modes; AIT/TDS §89 civil works 5% resident, non-resident distinct — never apply one to the other. VAT is a document-level line, never composed into a rate. TIN 12 digits, BIN 9–13, phone `01[3-9]XXXXXXXX`, no public NBR checksum — do not invent one. Fiscal year 1 July–30 June.

PPR 2025 (SRO 388-Law/2025, effective 28 Sep 2025) makes e-GP mandatory; ~143K tenderers, ~14K procuring entities. A works bid = submission letter + capacity forms + priced BOQ keyed into the portal + tender security (1–3%) + registration documents; a missing priced BOQ is automatic rejection; bidders do not submit rate analyses. Two automated price gates (Schedule 18, Rule 118(25)–(26)): a tender more than 10% above the Official Cost Estimate is non-responsive (hard ceiling 1.10 × OCE); the significantly-low floor `x̄ = 0.5·mean(responsive bids) + 0.2·OCE + 0.3·NPPI`, NPPI the e-GP national price index over a 28-day window, floor `x̄ − Sd`; scope domestic; LTM keeps ±5%; single-tender 20%. Tender BOQ shape: Item No / Item Code / Description / Unit / Quantity / Unit Price (figures and words) / Total; all taxes in unit rates; BDT only; provisional sums and daywork excluded from comparison; unpriced items deemed covered. Reconstructing the OCE and pricing into the bracket is the bid module's anchor.

Extract tables-first (model assist only where table extraction found nothing) → QA sheet with plausibility bands → the build refuses any row still carrying a flag → load. Human QA gate mandatory: 100% of flags reviewed, ≥10% spot-check per chapter; no model output reaches the database unreviewed. Cell-wrap normalisation at extraction. Loading is additive and id-preserving — never a wipe; new books load inactive; activation is an attributed human act. Zone rates store the published figure verbatim; derivations compute on read. Source PDF hash + page citations ride the dataset; parse failures are listed, never fabricated or dropped. Item provenance three-state: SOURCED · NO_SOR_EQUIVALENT (final, with reason) · NOT_YET_SOURCED. A market-sourced rate stores its quoted figure and unit as write-once provenance.

Six bills — Substructure · Superstructure · Finishes · Electrical · Plumbing · External — as swappable data, resolved most-specific-first: element-type override → division/group → division → UNCLASSIFIED (kept, labelled, reason stated, never dropped). The resolver records which row decided; the taxonomy version stamps every document; no project-name conditionals.

section.name: Formulas
section.law: Typed member geometry is a discriminated union — PRISM_RECT · PRISM_POLY · FRUSTUM_RECT · TAPER_LINEAR · AREA_THICK (and, for manual tools, POLYLINE · POLYGON · POINT_SET) — with no silent bounding-box fallback: a declared-but-malformed spec returns a reason and defers. A stored plan area disagreeing with its own polygon's shoelace by >0.5% refuses.

PRISM_POLY `count × (shoelace(plan) − Σ deductible openings) × depth`; FRUSTUM_RECT (prismoidal) `count × [h/6·(A₁ + 4·Aₘ + A₂) + A₁·h_base]`, `Aₘ = ((L₁+L₂)/2)·((W₁+W₂)/2)`; TAPER_LINEAR `count × ((A+B)/2) × span`; AREA_THICK `count × (area − openings) × thickness`; rect prism `count × L × B × H`. Vertical members expand per level from the level stack; a banded vertical prices each band's own section × count; a level no band covers defers.

law.name: Formwork (contact area on the real shape)

section.law: Polygonal foundation/cap: side faces only, `perimeter × depth`. Frustum: four inclined trapezoids + base-block sides `2·((L₁+L₂)/2)·√(h² + ((W₁−W₂)/2)²) + 2·((B₁+B₂)/2)·√(h² + ((L₁−L₂)/2)²) + 2(L₁+B₁)·h_base`. Tapered beam `(2·mean d + mean b) × span`, the top never counted. Slab: soffit area with rule-driven opening deduction. Beam `count × (2d + b) × L`. Foundation `count × 2(L+B) × depth`. Vertical `count × 2(L+B) × storey height` per level, band-aware.

Excavation `count × (L + 2a) × (B + 2a) × (depth + dx)` with working allowance `a` and depth extra `dx` from the edition; polygon/frustum pits defer. Blinding (CC) `count × (L + 2p) × (B + 2p) × t`; deferred for polygon plans.

law.name: Rebar and the bar bending schedule

section.law: Detailing rules are versioned data (`BNBC2020_BD @ 2026.07`): fy 420 MPa, f'c default 3000 psi; ℓd table in multiples of d_b (columns ≤19 / ≥20 mm): f'c 3000 → 44/54 confined, 66/83 otherwise; 3500 → 41/50, 61/78; 4000 → 38/47, 57/72; clamp f'c to the row at-or-below; top bar ×1.3; floor 300 mm. Laps Class A 1.0 ℓd / Class B 1.3 ℓd, floor 300 mm, compression ≈30d, default Class B. Hooks 90° = 12d; 180° = max(4d, 65 mm); stirrup 135° = max(6d, 75 mm); IS 2502 additive allowances 90° 12d, 135° 10d, 180° 9d; bend deductions 45° 1d, 90° 2d, 135° 3d, 180° 4d. Covers (mm) beam 25 · column 40 · wall 20 · slab 20 · footing/pile cap/pile 75. Tie spacing least(16·db_long, 48·db_tie, least dimension). Curtailment: extra top over supports Ln/3 each side; extra bottom ends L/4; 45° crank extra 0.42·D per crank. Wastage 3%; lap% 0 (laps modelled, never percentage-allowed); binding wire 8 kg/tonne; stock bar 12,000 mm. Unit weight lookup 8→0.395 · 10→0.616 · 12→0.888 · 16→1.579 · 20→2.466 · 22→2.98 · 25→3.854 · 28→4.828 · 32→6.313 · 36→7.981 · 40→9.864 kg/m. Cutting length by BS 8666 shape code (bend radius 2d ≤16 mm else 3.5d): 00 = A; 11 = A+B−0.5r−d; 21 = A+B+C−r−2d; 51 = 2(A+B+C)−2.5r−5d; generic Σlegs − bends·(0.5r+d); raw length never rounded, a separate rounded value (≤25 mm) is the only rounded surface; the IS-additive convention is what sites use and the IS↔BS divergence is recorded, never asserted equal. Synthesis per member class: through bars `span + 2·ℓd` stock-split with laps counted; extra top `2 × (Ln/3)`; closed link legs to the outer bend line (b−2c, d−2c) with 10d hooks and 3×90°+2×135° deductions, zones each `⌊dist/spacing⌋ + 1`; mat bar `net = dim − 2c` + 2×12d hooks − 2×90°, count `⌊(distDim − 2c)/spacing⌋ + 1`; column/wall vertical storey run + one storey lap; slab crank `clear span + 2ℓd + 2(0.42D) − 4×45° − 2×90°`. Counting rule `⌊(distance + 0.5 mm)/spacing⌋ + 1`. Stock splitting: `n = ⌈(L − lap)/(stock − lap)⌉`, billable `L + (n−1)·lap`; stock > lap; every piece ≤ stock. BBS assembly: bars/unit × parent count; weight = cutting length × kg/m; anchorage ends by role (MAIN both, DISTRIBUTION one, STIRRUP/TIE none); cutting stock as 1-D bin packing by diameter, first-fit-decreasing.

Two tiers: physical dimensions (MASS, VOLUME, LENGTH, AREA, COUNT; cross-dimension is `DIMENSION_MISMATCH`) and packaging units (bag, drum, coil…) that need a product property (`PRODUCT_FACTOR_MISSING`, never a silent 1.0). One factor per unit (`toCanonical`); every pair derives as a quotient. Canonicals kg · m³ · m · m² · pcs. Exact constants only: 0.028316846592 m³/cft · 0.3048 m/ft · 0.09290304 m²/sft · 1000 kg/MT · 0.45359237 kg/lb; a conversion literal outside the canon is a lint failure. Refusal is structural (the failure arm carries no value); rate bases (job, LS, per % cft, hour) are not units. Conversion is the last term of the formula `amount = rate × qty × convert(1, qtyUnit, rateBasisUnit)`; a rate converts inversely to a quantity (৳420/cft = ৳14,832/m³) in exactly one function at entry; quoted figure + unit stay write-once. Resource lookups key on (tenant, resource id), never a bare code.

All decimal. `materialRate = Σ(consumption × unitRate × (1 + wastage%)) / basisQty`; `labourRate = Σ(labour lines) / basisQty × floorMultiplier`; `equipmentRate = Σ(equipment lines) / basisQty`; `direct = material + labour + equipment`; `sundry = direct × sundry%`; `subTotal = direct + sundry`; `overhead = subTotal × overhead%` (PWD 2022: 3.5%); `profit = subTotal × profit%` (10%); `composite = subTotal + overhead + profit`. Overhead and profit ride the same subtotal additively, never compounded; a missing resource rate throws, never prices at zero; per-resource-line contributions are kept; floor escalation resolves by ordinal. Golden vectors are derived from the PWD published Analysis of Rates.
Every billable number is computed from human-confirmed inputs by pinned methods in decimal; a model never produces a quantity or a rate.

section.name: The model seam
section.law: `callModel` in core is the only path to a model; importing the SDK elsewhere is a lint error with a fixture test. It pins the model by id from a closed const, attributes tokens to a tenant, records every call (proposed or refused) in the model-call ledger with request hash, transport and outcome, and replays deterministically from fixtures inside verify (a missing fixture is `FIXTURE_MISSING`, never a network call).

It returns `Proposal<T> = { payload, sources: [SourceKey, ...], model, callId }` or a `Refusal` — never a conclusion, never a quantity. `sources` is a non-empty tuple resolved against the artifact before return (`UNSOURCED`, `SOURCE_UNRESOLVED`, `MALFORMED`); abstention is not the model's decision — the caller decides queue item or exclusion. Nothing in the schema accepts a Proposal; a proposal becomes an offer to the gate, a reading presented for disposition, or a classification held until confirmed. Cost is attributed and shown per tenant and per project.

Read and classify (sheet type, discipline, view captions, title blocks); propose scale evidence; propose element sightings and room outlines with cited entities; read schedules and notes on scans (a deterministic grammar is preferred where text is vector; a proposal where it is pixels); propose item mappings; flag anomalies against benchmarks; answer questions with citations; draft narrative prose (bid letters, summaries) that a human edits. It never writes a register row, a rate, a signature or an act.

section.name: Documents and formatting
section.law: `src/core/format.ts` is the tree's sole caller of `Intl` (including `Intl.Collator`); conventions are a named document-convention record (`BD_DOCUMENT`: `en-IN` numbering for lakh/crore grouping `1,00,00,000`, ASCII digits, `৳` prefixed, dates `DD MMM YYYY`, fiscal-year labels `FY2025-26`, Asia/Dhaka wall clock built from local parts) read by conventionless call sites, never an options bag. `toLocaleString` and `localeCompare` are lint errors; `en-BD` is not a CLDR locale (falls to Western grouping) and is banned.

The formatter does not round; it refuses a value not rounded to the stated per-kind precision (`PRECISION_NOT_APPLIED`); a number renders once per document; a unit renders from the enum, separately from its quantity; a character the pinned font lacks refuses `CHARACTER_NOT_COVERED`. Compact `L`/`Cr` never on a document.

Every issued document is generated server-side by the pinned renderer from a structured payload (strings cross as data, never interpolated markup), embeds its fonts (OFL, pinned by hash, licence text beside), is byte-deterministic for the same payload and renderer pin, carries the taxonomy version, act ids and instrument digests it was rendered under, and never signals by colour alone.

principles.principle: One application, one schema lane, one verification command, one obvious place for everything (B-03).
Six typed seams carry every rule that matters: tenant, act, gate, model, format, document. A rule enforced anywhere else is a rule that will be broken.
Modules are folders with one public index; core never imports a module; a module never deep-imports another. Future modules attach the same way.
Deterministic where it can be (keys, digests, documents, fixtures) so that a rebuild never re-asks a model and a test never flakes.

api-shape.rule: tRPC procedures are thin: authenticate, mint TenantCtx, call a module function, return typed data. Domain logic lives in modules.

Routers: `spine.*` (auth-adjacent, projects, participants, drawings, sets, jobs, documents, search, comments), `takeoff.*`, `assure.*`, `book.*`, `estimate.*`, `bid.*`, `ai.*` (proposals; every procedure returns Proposal|Refusal shapes).
Mutations that are acts take `{ input, consequenceDigest }` and expose a sibling `preview` procedure (L-ACT-02).
Uploads and downloads are route handlers (`/api/upload`, `/api/documents/:id`, `/api/exports/:id`) with signed, expiring URLs; job progress via `/api/events` (SSE) with polling fallback.
A public REST/OpenAPI surface is out of scope until a named customer needs it (the module functions are its future).

deployment.dev: Native: Postgres 16 on 5544, `pnpm dev` (web on 3210 + worker), `pnpm e2e` (build once, `next start` on 3211 against a scratch DB, run journeys). No Docker in dev.
deployment.prod: One container image; external Postgres (managed), S3-compatible object storage, one web process + N worker processes; `/healthz` and `/readyz`; structured JSON logs; nightly `pg_dump` script; environment through variables only; secrets never in the image.
deployment.observability: Request ids, job ids and act ids in every log line; a `/admin/health` screen (R-SPINE-080); model-call cost per tenant; slow-query log; error reporting hook (Sentry-compatible endpoint optional).
