Every user gets a personal tenant at sign-up (in the user-create transaction); a user may belong to many tenants; the active tenant is explicit in the URL (`/t/{tenantSlug}/…`) and in the session.

Tenant admin: invite by email (pending invitations, resend, revoke), members list, tenant roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER), remove member (refused while the member holds acts on open campaigns: `MEMBER_HAS_ACTS`).
Every query runs through SEAM-TENANT; the live seam test proves scoped read, RLS refusal and cross-tenant write refusal on every table that carries tenant_id.
Google sign-in; SSO out of scope.

capability.name: Projects and participants
capability.requirement: Create/edit/archive project: name, code, client, site address + district (drives zone per book), building type (residential, commercial, mixed, industrial, infrastructure), storeys, target GFA (m² and sft display), notes; creator becomes PRINCIPAL in the same transaction (L-ACT-03).
Participants: assign roles by act (`ASSIGN_PARTICIPANT_ROLE`) with preview → consequence; role history visible; last PRINCIPAL protected.

Project pins a rule-set edition at creation (fork of the tenant template, itself a fork of the platform seed); the settings screen shows edition, digest, lineage, and parameter table; authoring a new edition is an act with a diff view (M3).
Project home: drawings, sets, campaigns, estimates, bids, participants, recent activity, cost-of-AI-so-far; quick actions.
Project templates (default books, markups, taxonomy) per tenant.

capability.name: Files, storage, uploads
capability.requirement: Resumable multi-file upload (drag-drop, folder, .zip) up to 500 MB per file: DWG, DXF, PDF, PNG/JPG/TIFF; sha256 computed client- and server-side; duplicate content detected and linked, not re-stored; virus-scan hook point.
Storage adapter (local/S3) with content addressing, signed download URLs, per-tenant prefixes, retention of every revision forever (drawings are evidence).
Thumbnails and page rasters generated by a job at three zoom tiers per sheet for the sheet index and viewer background (raster PDFs and scans).

capability.name: Jobs and events
capability.requirement: pg-boss queues per job kind with concurrency limits, retries with backoff (idempotent by key), dead-letter view; job progress events streamed to the UI (SSE) with per-step status, timings and named refusals; a job never fails silently.
Worker process separate from web (`pnpm worker`), same codebase; health endpoint; graceful shutdown; a job's temp dir is per invocation.

capability.name: Documents
capability.requirement: SEAM-DOC renders any document kind from a Zod payload via pinned Typst; the rendered PDF is stored with payload digest, renderer pin, font hashes, act ids, and served by signed URL; the same payload renders byte-identical (golden PDF test); documents list per project with kind, version, issued-by, superseded-by.
Excel (.xlsx) and CSV exports through one export seam (SheetJS-free: `exceljs`), with formulas preserved where the artifact spec says so (A-BOQ-XLSX).

capability.name: Search, notifications, comments, activity
capability.requirement: Command palette (⌘K): navigate to any project, drawing, sheet, campaign, estimate, bid, book item; run actions ("Affirm scale…", "Export BOQ…"); recent items; keyboard-first.

Comments with @mentions on sheets (pinned to a world coordinate + optional entity keys), on register lines, on estimate lines and on bids; resolve/reopen; activity feed per project; in-app notifications with unread state; email digests optional.
Full-text search across sheet text (extracted strings with source keys), item descriptions, notes; results deep-link to the sheet and highlight the entity.

capability.name: Platform, settings, i18n readiness, health
capability.requirement: Every user-facing string lives in one typed string table (`src/ui/strings.ts` per module) keyed by id with English values; the compiler refuses a missing key; no string literals in JSX except test ids and codes. Not a translation system — a readiness rule.
Numbers, dates, currency and units render only through SEAM-FORMAT with `BD_DOCUMENT` conventions (lakh/crore, ৳ prefix, DD MMM YYYY, tabular numerals in UI).
Closed refusal taxonomy in `src/core/errors.ts`: every code has an English message, a remedy hint, a severity and a surface hint; the refusal register test (Q-07) covers it.
Plans and entitlements table (projects, sheets, AI budget); read-only "your plan" screen; no payments.
Admin/health screen: DB, storage, worker liveness, queue depths, renderer and CAD toolchain versions and hashes, model spend by tenant, recent job failures.

Audit surfaces: act log explorer per project (filter by act type, actor, subject; each act shows its consequence and cited evidence), model-call ledger per project (calls, cost, outcome), job history.

module.name: Takeoff — from drawings to a bill of quantities

capability.name: Drawing intake and organisation
capability.requirement: Ingest DXF and DWG (LibreDWG two-pass audited) into EntityGraph v2 via `cad/`; record extractor identity, fidelity counters (per type, per page: explode truncation, flatten cap, stray rejection, dropped layouts, DWG census shortfalls) and show them on the sheet card as named facts.

Ingest vector PDF (pypdfium2): each page a sheet; page objects → EntityGraph entities with `PDF_OBJECT` keys (L-CAD-02); Form XObjects treated as blocks; text with anchor and height; multi-sheet PDFs split with the sheet index proposed from title blocks.

Ingest raster (scanned PDF pages, PNG/JPG/TIFF): deskew + denoise + vectorise into `RASTER_TRACE` primitives with a pinned deterministic vectoriser id/version/DPI; every derived line is INTERPRETED and needs corroboration before publishing (L-QTY-04); mixed pages (drafted sheet with a pasted scan) mint both schemes.

Sheet index: one card per sheet with thumbnail, proposed sheet number/title (title-block read via a deterministic grammar first, then a model proposal with cited entities), discipline proposal (STRUCTURAL, ARCHITECTURAL, MEP, CIVIL, OTHER) awaiting confirmation (`CONFIRM_DISCIPLINE`), format/scheme badges, fidelity facts, scale state (unaffirmed/affirmed/unplaceable), view count; filter and search; bulk confirm through offered groups only (L-ACT-02).

Drawing sets: group sheets into a set; every upload of a changed file for an existing drawing creates a drawing revision (content hash); pin a drawing-set revision (content-addressed manifest) as the object a campaign measures (L-REG-06); set browser shows members and revisions.
Duplicate/near-duplicate sheet detection (same content hash across drawings; same title block + different content flagged as a revision candidate).

capability.name: The drawing viewer (S-Viewer)
capability.requirement: Renders an EntityGraph sheet at 60 fps for ≥100k entities on a 2023 laptop: pan, zoom (mouse, trackpad, keyboard, fit, zoom-to-selection), minimap, rotate 90° steps; resolved colours; text at world height; layers panel with visibility/isolate/lock, colour swatch and entity counts; light and dark canvas.

Entity inspector: hover reveals type/layer/handle; click selects; multi-select by rectangle/lasso/layer; the source key is copyable; "reveal in sheet" from any register line, queue item, certificate cell or BOQ line highlights the cited entities and flies to them (the Trace, one of the signature moments).

Snapping: endpoint, midpoint, intersection, perpendicular, grid intersection, nearest-on-entity, with visible snap glyphs; ortho and angle lock; distance readout on hover between two picks in drawing units and, once affirmed, metres.

Split view (two sheets side by side, linked zoom optional) and overlay compare (two revisions of one sheet tinted, with two-point manual registration and an "align by grid" proposal); overlays are visual aids only and never move a measurement.

Views and grid on the sheet: view partition outlines with type badges; grid axes and bubbles drawn as detected; toggling shows what the machine sees; an untyped view is visibly hatched with its reason.

Measurement overlays: every published quantity's geometry paints on the sheet in its class colour with a legend; filter by class/kind/basis; basis is encoded by both colour and glyph; toggling "unmeasured" reveals residue cells' sighted evidence.
Text search within a sheet and across a set (vector text and OCR'd raster text with source keys) with hit navigation.
Print/export the sheet with overlays and legend to PDF (vector where the source is vector) — A-SHEET-PDF.

capability.name: Scale and calibration
capability.requirement: Scale panel per sheet: machine proposals ranked (grid-spacing match, dimension ratio, units header) with the evidence entities and computed factor pair; QS two-point calibration tool that requires two cited points and an entered distance with unit; anisotropy and single-observation checks shown; the affirmation act names its views (a scale group), previews consequences (lines that re-derive, signatures that void), then commits (`AFFIRM_SCALE`).
Unplaceable views are hatched with `SCALE_NO_EVIDENCE` / `SCALE_UNIT_UNMAPPED` and measure nothing; the sheet card shows the count; the certificate declares.

capability.name: Structural auto-takeoff (the engine)
capability.requirement: View classification (L-CAD-06), grid backbone (L-CAD-07), convention profile (L-CAD-08) run as a stored partition rebuilt per ingest; each stage's result is visible and confirmable; the model may propose captions/classes where the grammar is silent (cited).

Column placement from layout plans (content-scaled placement, label normalisation, grid reference), level expansion for vertical classes (typical ranges from captions; `AUTHOR_TYPICAL_RANGE` when unstated), member-type registry from schedules (sections, rebar zones), and the first rail: RCC column concrete — the vertical slice that ends in a bill line with basis, coverage, calibration and a certificate cell (M2 exit).

Rails and methods for: footings and pile caps (rect and polygon), piles (count × length), tie/grade beams, beams (long-section spans, junction in beam), slabs (soffit area, thickness, openings), shear walls, stairs (flights and landings as AREA_THICK; deferral for complex), lintels; per class: concrete by grade, formwork by member sub-item, rebar/BBS from schedules + detailing rules (L-FRM-05) with laps, hooks, cutting lists and cutting-stock; brickwork by nominal thickness; plaster/paint faces with scheduled openings; excavation and blinding with SITE facts.

Levels editor: level stack (label, ordinal, height readings with basis and source), insert/repudiate with consequences, storey-height readings that corroborate/suspend, per-level roll-ups; typical-range authoring UI.

Schedules & notes workspace: reconstructed schedule tables shown beside the sheet region with every cell linked to its entities; member-type registry (mark families, variants, zones); notes readings proposed by grammar (deterministic) and committed per sheet (`TRANSCRIBE_SHEET_NOTES`), recording accepted-as-proposed vs edited; suspensions visible.
Golden vectors: the synthetic six-storey RCC fixture and its hand takeoff; ±3%/+0% per class × kind (L-QTY-06) enforced by `pnpm test:golden`; validation observations recorded as data.

Architectural auto-detection: room/space outlines from wall geometry with the model proposing names from labels (cited), giving finish faces (floor, ceiling, wall faces) as offers under the face algebra; doors and windows from schedules × placements; the QS confirms rooms in bulk by offered group.

Learn-and-count symbols: pick a symbol instance (block name or a traced region), the engine finds similar instances across sheets by content signature (blocks) or by shape match (raster, INTERPRETED); results are sightings reviewed sheet by sheet with exclusion zones; counts enter as offers with COUNT dimension bindings.
MEP: pipe/duct/conduit runs by diameter/size from lines and text (network algebra), lengths only; fittings deferred by rule (L-MEA-08).

capability.name: Manual measurement tools, conditions and assemblies
capability.requirement: Tools: count (click, with symbol snap), linear (polyline, segments shown, pitch multiplier), area (polygon, rectangle, freehand, magic fill for closed regions), volume (area × depth), perimeter, cutout/deduct, typical multiplier, "select entities on layer within region" — every measurement is an act with geometry citing the entities snapped to (basis MEASURED when snapped to vector geometry, INTERPRETED on raster, ENTERED when free-drawn without snaps — shown as such); results are offers to the gate under a chosen kind, never lines the tool writes.

Conditions (PlanSwift/OST-class): a named measurement recipe binding a geometry type + attributes to one or more quantity kinds via formulas from the method registry (e.g. "230 mm brick wall, 3.0 m high" → brickwork volume, plaster both faces, paint both faces); a tool chest per tenant and per project; hotkeys; a condition's colour and hatch feed the legend.

Assemblies: composite conditions producing many kinds from one measurement with quantity factors (e.g. per m² of slab: concrete, formwork, rebar kg from a rate); assemblies are edition-parameterised data; a QS may author and share them.

Measurement list: a live table of manual measurements (sheet, condition, geometry summary, quantities per kind, basis, calibration) with inline edit via new acts, bulk re-assign of condition by offered group, and export.
Legend on sheet: auto-placed legend of conditions with colours and quantities for the visible sheet; included in A-SHEET-PDF.

capability.name: Register, lines, coverage
capability.requirement: Register workspace: a tree by discipline → level → class → object with per-object attributes (basis, role, corroboration state), lines per kind (SI value, formula with variables, bases, coverage, calibration, engine), refusals/deferrals with reason codes, and the Trace to the sheet; virtualised for 50k rows.
Every human change is an act adding a competing observation with declared precedence; disagreements suspend and show as such; corroboration/repudiation acts; nothing overwrites (L-ACT-01).

Coverage grid (S-Coverage): the residue as a heat grid (kind × class × level) with causes and human-only exclusions (`NOT_IN_PROJECT_SCOPE`, `HOLD_OUT_OF_BILL`) as acts with consequences; click a cell → its sighted evidence and rail observations.

Bill of Quantities (unpriced): grouped by the taxonomy (L-BD-08), lines with quantity, unit, basis glyphs, coverage, and the measured-scope subtotal rule; export A-BOQ-PDF (bound with certificate — requires assure M7 for signature; before M7 exports carry a DRAFT — UNSIGNED banner) and A-BOQ-XLSX.

Bar bending schedule view and export (A-BBS): per member/bar mark, shape code, dimensions, cutting length (raw and rounded), count, weight, laps shown as their own component; cutting-stock summary by diameter.

Quantity dashboards: totals by class/kind/level, concrete by grade, steel by diameter, formwork by member, brickwork by thickness; per-level and per-tower comparisons; anomaly hints (model, cited) against benchmarks.

capability.name: Revisions and deltas (DIFF-3, narrowed)
capability.requirement: Re-issue: upload revised sheets → new drawing revisions → new set revision; the re-pin act previews consequences (re-presenting rows, widened denominators, voided signatures) and commits; pairing per L-REG-05 carries dispositions where semantics are unchanged.

Delta view: per object and kind, before/after quantity, changed/added/removed/re-sheeted, with the reason (geometry moved, attribute corrected, level inserted, evidence moved); "re-present" queue for disposition; priced delta through estimate and bid versions (M9).
Revision report document (A-DELTA-PDF).

capability.name: Exports
capability.requirement: Quantities export: XLSX/CSV with every line and its bases; JSON of the register (documented shape) for integrations.

module.name: Assure — review, dip sample, signature, certificate
module.requirement: Directed review queue (S-Review): rows per (subject, disjunct) with derived order, subject rendered in context (the reading, the cell, the act) with a Trace; disposition act with outcome and, on exception, the competing observation in one transaction; bulk only where offered; `DISPOSITION_SELF_REVIEWED` refused; progress shown as enumeration, never percent.

Dip sample (S-Sample): draw (act, seed minted in transaction, N shown with its arithmetic, stratum table, remainder basis MONEY/UNIFORM); the blind entry workspace presents each draw's object and kind with the drawing region and asks for the QS's own figure before revealing the machine figure (write-once, `BLIND_ENTRY_MISSING` on early reveal); comparison with direction (under/over) and the reach it condemns; abandon draw with cause; failure outputs: fix input or move boundary.

Signature (S-Sign): preconditions computed and listed (Part A reviewed in full, Part A ≤ Part B, not stale, no unresolved suspensions inside boundary, no over-measurement); verdict + mandatory reliability statement + credential captured; the signed object's digests displayed; void triggers listed; supersede flow when a re-issue is owed (L-REG-08).
Certificate of Measured Coverage rendered exactly per L-QTY-07 and bound with the bill into one PDF (A-BILL-PDF); certificate preview screen mirrors the document.
Validation ledger screen: observations per (engine, class, kind), provenance, instruments cited, liveness; authoring a golden observation from a hand takeoff (act).
RICS pack: one document assembling the reliability decision, dip sample record, certificate and AI disclosure (A-RICS-PDF).
Issued bills register: every issued/superseded bill with its documents, signature, sample, and the re-issue-owed indicator computed live.

capability.name: Schedules of Rates and custom books
capability.requirement: Book model: book (publisher PWD/LGED/RHD/CUSTOM/UNIFIED), edition (name, effective-from, VAT-embedded %, source PDF hash, activation act), chapters (tree with dotted codes), items (code, description = method of measurement, unit from the canon, kind, `isRateModifier`, base item link, provenance state), zone columns per edition (district-group keys with display letters as edition aliases), item zone rates (verbatim published figure), district→zone map rows (authored, cited), added-rate items, Ch. 33 uplifts as project-level modifiers.

Platform books ship as data: PWD SoR 2022 (three editions: original, Revised 2023, 2nd Revised 2026 — Part A Civil Works), LGED SoR 2022 (3rd ed.), RHD SoR (latest reachable) — digitised through the pipeline (R-BK-030) with source page citations; the fixture chapter (two pages, fictional) proves the chain in verify.

Book explorer (S-Book): browse chapters, search items by code/description/kind with synonyms (e.g. "shuttering" → formwork), compare rates across editions and zones, see rate movement, open an item's rate analysis, see which register kinds map to it and which projects used it.

Custom books (tenant): create a market/real-estate book, add items (kind mandatory or an authored exclusion reason), rates by district/zone effective-dated, import from XLSX with a mapping wizard, correction slips as new effective-dated rows never edits.
Cross-book citations (LGED referring to PWD items) rendered as links; book-scoped scope rulings displayed on the item.

capability.name: Resources, norms and rate analysis
capability.requirement: Resources (materials, labour, equipment) per tenant with unit, packaging factors (product properties), and effective-dated rates per district; PWD front-matter labour/material/carriage rates loaded as a platform resource set per edition.

Norms (analysis of rates) per item: consumption lines (resource, quantity per basis quantity, wastage%), labour lines, equipment lines, sundry/overhead/profit parameters; computed composite per L-FRM-07 with per-line contributions; PWD Analysis of Rates golden vectors; a "build your own rate" workspace with live composite (Candy-class), copy-from-book, and version history.
Floor multiplier schemes (by ordinal), inaccessible-area categories, lead/lift bands as data; tax tables (VAT/AIT effective-dated, % and per-unit).

capability.name: Mapping quantities to items
capability.requirement: Mapping dictionary: (tenant, kind, class, attribute predicates) → item, learned from estimator selections; automatic matcher trade-first with dimension veto (L-MEA-04); confidence is never shown as a number — instead the evidence (which kind, which chapter, which unit lock) is shown; no confident trade ⇒ unpriced.
Model-assisted mapping proposals for custom-book items with cited item text (L-AI-03), accepted or edited by the estimator, recorded as such.

capability.name: Digitisation pipeline
capability.requirement: Pipeline (job): PDF → page tables (pdfium text + geometry-based table reconstruction; model assist only where tables were not found, cited by page) → normalised rows → QA sheet with plausibility flags (rate bands per unit and chapter, monotone zone patterns, unit vocabulary, code grammar) → human QA console (S-Digitise) requiring 100% flags reviewed and ≥10% spot-check per chapter with per-row accept/edit/reject and page image beside → build refuses while flags remain → additive id-preserving load, inactive → activation act. Every row carries page citation and source hash.
Correction-slip ingestion for an active edition as new effective-dated rate rows with citation.

module.name: Estimate — priced bills
module.requirement: Create an estimate from a campaign (its published lines) or from a manual quantity import; an estimate pins book edition(s), zone (from project district per book), floor multiplier scheme, tax profile and taxonomy version; versions are immutable snapshots; a working version is editable through acts (`PRICE`).

Pricing: each line's item selection (auto via dictionary/matcher, or estimator pick — machine answer kept beside), rate from the pinned edition and zone or from a custom book/rate analysis, unit conversion as the last term with the factor shown, added-rate items generated beside base items (excavation depth/lead bands, floor extras, Ch. 33 uplift), rate-modifier lines inheriting quantities; missing selection → visibly unpriced; missing rate → `RATE_MISSING`, never zero.

The estimate workspace (S-Estimate): a virtualised BOQ table by section (taxonomy) with inline item search, rate override with reason (act, kept beside book rate), quantity source glyphs (basis, coverage) that Trace back to the sheet, section subtotals, measured-scope subtotal rule under incomplete coverage, markups panel (overhead, profit, contingency, escalation, risk — additive per L-FRM-07 unless a rate already composes them; shown), tax panel (VAT/AIT display lines per L-BD-05), summary sheet, resource summary (total cement, sand, aggregate, steel by diameter, bricks…) derived from norms, cost per m²/sft by building and by level, and per-tower comparison.
Scenarios: price the same quantities under another edition/zone/book or with a market-rate override set; side-by-side deltas by section and item; scenario becomes a version by act.
Version comparison: line-level diff between versions (quantity, rate, amount, cause: revision delta / rate change / selection change / markup change) — the priced delta of DIFF-3 lands here in M9.

Exports: A-BOQ-PDF (priced; bound certificate where the campaign is signed; DRAFT banner otherwise), A-BOQ-XLSX (formulas preserved: quantity × rate = amount, section sums, summary), A-RATE-ANALYSIS-PDF (per item build-ups), A-RESOURCE-PDF, CSV in e-GP BOQ shape (A-EGP-CSV), JSON.
Approval act on a version (ESTIMATOR/PRINCIPAL) with consequence preview; approved versions are read-only and referenced by bids.
Benchmarks: tenant cost history by building type (cost/sft, steel kg/m², concrete m³/m²) with anonymised platform bands where ≥ N tenants; anomaly hints on lines (model, cited) never blocking.
Client proposal document for private works (A-PROPOSAL-PDF): a simplified priced summary with assumptions and exclusions from the certificate; the B2C surface reuses it.

module.name: Bid — tender preparation for e-GP and private works
module.requirement: Tender intake: create a tender (procuring entity, e-GP id, dates, security %, evaluation type), import the tender BOQ (CSV/XLSX; PDF via table extraction with QA like R-BK-030 for the tender pack) as tender items (item no, code, description, unit, quantity); map tender items to book items and to our estimate lines (dictionary + estimator confirmation); unmapped items visible.

OCE reconstruction: price the tender BOQ under the procuring entity's presumed schedule (book + edition + zone chosen with evidence, e.g. tender date vs effective dates) to reconstruct the Official Cost Estimate; show per-item and total; sensitivity to edition/zone; assumptions named on the face.

The bracket (S-Bracket): hard ceiling 1.10 × OCE; significantly-low floor from `x̄ = 0.5·mean(bids) + 0.2·OCE + 0.3·NPPI`, floor `x̄ − Sd`, with entered/imported inputs (expected rival bids as scenarios, NPPI value with source and date, Sd assumption) — every input a named assumption; an interactive band showing OCE, ceiling, floor, our cost, our bid, margin; scope note (domestic works; LTM ±5%; single-tender 20%).

Bid strategy: target margin, per-item loading/unbalancing with limits (max deviation per item vs OCE unit rate; front-loading indicator), risk and contingency allowances, discount lines; the bid total tracked against the bracket live; a strategy is an act with versions.

Bid documents: A-EGP-BOQ (priced BOQ in the portal's shape with unit prices in figures and words, BDT, all taxes included), A-BID-BOOK-PDF (cover, submission summary, priced BOQ, rate summary, assumptions, exclusions, bracket analysis), CSV/XLSX for portal entry; a submission checklist (security, forms) tracked manually.

Outcomes: record the result (won/lost/withdrawn), rival bids and the published OCE where known; the analytics screen shows our position vs OCE and floor across tenders, win rate by procuring entity and margin, and NPPI drift.
Private-works quotation: from an approved estimate produce a quotation/proposal (A-PROPOSAL-PDF) with validity, payment terms and exclusions.
Bid narrative assistant: drafts submission letter and method statement outline from project facts (model, edited by human, disclosed as AI-drafted internally).

module.name: AI — cross-cutting proposals through the model seam
module.requirement: Sheet understanding: title-block fields, sheet number/title, discipline, view captions where the grammar is silent — proposals with cited entities; fixture-replayed in verify; live via `callModel` in production; every proposal accepted/edited/rejected is recorded.

Scan reading: schedule cells and general notes on raster sheets proposed from OCR (deterministic engine first) and, where illegible, the model with cited RASTER_TRACE regions; the QS commits per sheet.

Ask the drawings (S-Ask): natural-language questions over the project's sheets, register and estimate ("how many C3 columns on level 5?", "which sheets carry the door schedule?", "why is item 07.9 unpriced?") answered from data with citations that highlight entities/rows; the model composes the answer from tool results (register queries, sheet text search) and never invents numbers — every number in an answer is a query result rendered by the formatter.
Anomaly hints: lines outside class-typical bands (per building type benchmarks) flagged with an explanation and the comparison; never blocking, never on the certificate.
AI cost and disclosure: per-project model spend, calls, and outcomes on the project home; the certificate's AI disclosure lists model ids used for accepted proposals inside the boundary.

design-system.name: Datum
design-system.tagline: a reference everything is measured from
design-system.intent: A precision instrument for people who read drawings all day: calm, dense where data lives, generous where decisions are made, monochrome by default so that colour means something. Dark-first (long hours on drawings), light mode complete. It must feel like the best of Linear, Figma and a well-made surveying instrument — never like a dashboard template.

tokens.requirement: Tokens are CSS variables emitted from one TS source (`src/ui/tokens.ts`) consumed by Tailwind: colour (graphite scale 0–1000 for surfaces/text; one accent "cobalt" for interactive; semantic success/warn/danger/info; the basis palette; element-class palette; canvas palette), spacing (4-pt grid), radii (2/4/8/12), elevation (four shadows, hairline borders preferred over shadows), typography scale, motion durations/easings, z-layers, breakpoints. Both themes defined on `:root` and `[data-theme]`; no colour literal outside tokens (lint rule with fixture test).

Basis palette (fixed): MEASURED teal · TRANSCRIBED blue · DERIVED violet · IMPORTED slate · ENTERED amber · INTERPRETED magenta · DEFAULTED grey; each basis also has a glyph (◆ ▣ ƒ ⇩ ✎ ▦ ○) so it survives greyscale and colour-blindness; the pair renders everywhere a basis appears (chips, table cells, sheet overlays, documents).

Typography: Inter for UI (14 px base, 13 px in dense tables, 1.45 line height), JetBrains Mono for every number, code, mark, source key and formula with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero`; document typography Noto Sans; a type scale of 12/13/14/16/20/24/32; headings weight 600, body 400/500; never letter-spaced uppercase for labels except tiny overlines.

Motion: 120–200 ms ease-out for state changes; 240 ms for panels; the viewer "fly-to" 320 ms with easing; no bounce; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected everywhere; loading uses skeletons that keep layout, never spinners on data tables.
Density: two modes (comfortable 36 px rows, compact 28 px) persisted per user; tables use hairline dividers and right-aligned numerals; the workspace uses resizable panels with remembered sizes.

components.requirement: Primitives (restyled Radix): Button (primary/secondary/ghost/danger; loading; icon), IconButton, Input, NumberInput (unit suffix, decimal only, lakh/crore display on blur), Select, Combobox (async, keyboard), Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Slider, Textarea, Tabs, Tooltip, Popover, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Dialog, Sheet (side panel), Toast (sonner), Badge/Chip, Tag, Avatar, Breadcrumb, Kbd, Progress (determinate only where known), Skeleton, Separator, ScrollArea, Resizable panels, Command palette, DataTable (TanStack; column pin/resize/sort/filter/group; virtualised; sticky header/footer; row selection; inline edit cell), Tree, EmptyState, ErrorState, RefusalState (renders a reason code with message + remedy + evidence link), ConsequenceDialog (the preview → confirm pattern for every act), EvidenceLink (the Trace affordance), BasisChip, CoverageChip, UnitBadge, MoneyText, QuantityText, DateText, RelativeTime, Stat tile, Sparkline, Chart wrappers.
A living gallery at `/design` renders every component in every state in both themes with sample data; the visual baseline suite screenshots it; a component without a gallery entry fails a test.
Every interactive element: focus ring (2 px cobalt outer), keyboard reachable, ARIA labelled; colour contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for text (≥ 3:1 large/UI); axe serious/critical = 0 on every screen (Q-11).

patterns.requirement: Refusal pattern: a refusal is never a toast alone; it renders in place with code, message, remedy and a link to the evidence or setting that resolves it; silence never happens (an empty list says why it is empty).

Act pattern: every act opens a ConsequenceDialog showing the typed consequence (counts of rows affected, signatures voided, denominators widened) computed by the server; confirm carries the digest; a stale digest re-renders the dialog with what changed.

Trace pattern: any number, cell or row that came from a drawing carries an EvidenceLink; activating it opens/focuses the viewer, flies to the entities, pulses them, and shows the formula with live variables in the inspector; back returns to the origin.

Offered-group pattern: bulk actions are offered as named groups ("14 columns sighted from view B-2, layer S-COL, basis INTERPRETED") with a live membership count; there is no select-all over heterogeneous rows.
Job pattern: long operations show a job timeline (steps, timings, named refusals) inline where they were started and in a global jobs tray; results appear without reload.

shell.requirement: Layout: left rail (tenant switcher, Projects, Books, Settings; collapsible), top bar (breadcrumb, project switcher, ⌘K, jobs tray, notifications, user), main area, right inspector (context-sensitive: entity/line/item detail), bottom status line in the viewer (coordinates, scale state, snap mode, selection count).

Navigation: URL is the source of truth (`/t/{tenant}/p/{project}/{area}/…`), deep-linkable to a sheet + viewport + selection, to a register line, to a queue row, to an estimate line, to a bid item; browser back works everywhere.

Keyboard: global shortcuts (⌘K palette, G then P/D/T/E/B go-to, ? shortcut sheet), viewer tools (V select, H pan, M measure menu, C count, L linear, A area, S snap toggle, F fit, Esc), table navigation (arrows, enter to edit, tab), documented in the ? sheet and in the palette.

Onboarding: first sign-in → create tenant name → first project → the empty states teach the next action (upload a drawing) with a sample project one click away (the synthetic fixture set, clearly labelled SAMPLE).

screens.screen: Sign in / sign up / magic link / reset / accept invitation. Minimal, branded, fast.
Projects grid/list with status, last activity, quick stats (sheets, campaigns, estimates, bids); create project; recent documents.
Project home: header (name, client, district→zone badges per book, GFA), tabs Drawings · Takeoff · Assure · Estimate · Bid · Activity · Settings; AI spend; participants.
Sheet index (cards/table), sets & revisions browser, upload dropzone, fidelity facts, discipline confirmation, scale state; open in viewer.
Full-bleed canvas; left: layers/views/grid panels; right: inspector (entity, line, scale, condition); toolbar (select, pan, measure tools, snap, split, overlay); bottom status; the Trace target.
Scale panel docked in the viewer: proposals with evidence, two-point tool, group membership, affirm act.
Register workspace: tree + lines table + inspector; filters by class/kind/level/basis/coverage; refusals; the Trace.
Level stack editor with height readings and consequences.
Reconstructed schedules and notes beside their sheet region; member-type registry; transcription acts.
The coverage grid (kind × class × level heat grid) with causes and boundary acts; certificate preview.
Manual measurement mode in the viewer: tool chest, conditions/assemblies editor, measurement list, legend.
Unpriced bill by taxonomy with subtotal rules; exports.
Bar bending schedule and cutting-stock.
Directed review queue with in-context subjects and disposition acts.
Dip sample: draw, blind entry, comparison, abandonment.
Signature: preconditions, verdict, statement, credential, issue.
Issued bills and documents; supersede.
Book explorer, item detail with rate analysis and zone rates, custom books, resources, taxes, multipliers, mapping dictionary.
Digitisation QA console: page image beside extracted rows, flags, accept/edit/reject, chapter spot-check meter, build/activate.
The estimate workspace (R-ES-003), scenarios, versions, approvals, exports.
Tender intake, mapping, OCE reconstruction, bracket, strategy, documents, outcomes.
The interactive band (part of S-Bid; also a standalone share view).
Ask the drawings: conversational panel with cited answers.
Tenant: members, invitations, roles, books, templates; Project: rule set edition, participants, taxonomy, tax profile, multipliers.
Act log explorer, model ledger, jobs.
Health and platform view.
The living component gallery.

viewer-spec.requirement: Rendering pipeline: server builds a render manifest per view/sheet (colour resolved, text at world height, every entity keyed) → client tessellates into WebGL batches by layer; level-of-detail hides text below legibility; culling by viewport; hit-testing via a spatial index (R-tree) in a worker; selection and hover never drop below 60 fps at 100k entities; raster sheets render as tiled backgrounds with vector traces above.
Coordinate model: drawing units on the canvas; SI shown when calibrated; a status readout in both; snapping computed in drawing units, quantised per L-REG-04 for keys.

Measurement tools follow a consistent gesture grammar (click-click-… enter/double-click to close; Esc cancels; backspace undoes a vertex; shift constrains); every completed measurement opens a compact inline card (condition/kind, quantity per kind, basis) with "confirm" as the act.
Viewer never blocks: heavy sheets show progressive loading by layer; the manifest is cached by content hash; a broken manifest shows a RefusalState with the fidelity facts.

states.requirement: Every screen defines and renders: loading (skeleton), empty (teaches next action), error (retry + report id), refusal (code + remedy), partial (some rows refused: shown, not hidden), offline (banner; read-only), permission-denied (what permission, who holds it).

signature-moments.moment: Drop a DWG/PDF set; the job timeline animates ingestion; sheets fan out as cards with proposed titles, disciplines and scale proposals; fidelity facts appear as calm badges. It should feel instant and honest.

Click a quantity anywhere; the viewer flies to the region, the source entities pulse in the basis colour, the formula appears with live variables. Bidirectional: click entities on the sheet → the lines that cite them.
The residue as a heat grid you can read in five seconds: what is measured, what is not, and why — every cell a cause, every cause a remedy.
The dip sample asks for your figure first; the reveal is a small, deliberate moment; the certificate says exactly what that proves.
OCE, ceiling, floor and your bid on one band, live to every strategy change, with each assumption a chip you can question.

moment.name: Revision three does not reset the bill

signature-moments.moment: A re-issue lands; the delta view shows what moved and what carried, priced through to the bid.
A question, an answer, and every number in it clickable back to a sheet or a row.

performance-budgets.budget: First contentful paint ≤ 1.5 s, interactive ≤ 3 s on the project home over a 10 Mbps link (production build).
Sheet open ≤ 2 s to first paint for a 100k-entity sheet from a warm manifest cache; ≤ 6 s cold.
60 fps pan/zoom at 100k entities; hit-test ≤ 16 ms.
Register/BOQ tables: 50k rows scroll at 60 fps; filter ≤ 200 ms.
Ingest: 50-sheet DXF set ≤ 3 min end-to-end on the reference machine; PDF vector ≤ 5 min; raster vectorise ≤ 30 s per A1 sheet at 300 DPI.
Document render: bill + certificate for 5,000 lines ≤ 20 s.
tRPC p95 ≤ 300 ms for reads, ≤ 800 ms for act commits (excluding jobs).

accessibility.requirement: WCAG 2.2 AA on every screen: keyboard operability including the viewer's tools (with an accessible measurement entry alternative), visible focus, labels, live regions for job status, no colour-only meaning (basis glyphs, hatch patterns), reduced motion, 200% zoom without loss.

artifacts.artifact: The issued Bill of Quantities bound with its Certificate of Measured Coverage (L-QTY-07): cover (project, campaign, set revision digest, rule-set edition, book edition if priced, taxonomy version, issued date, responsible surveyor, credential), the bill by section with per-kind rounding, measured-scope subtotal rule, the certificate (measurement statement, bill statement, instruments, UNVALIDATED, actors + concentration, raster disclosure, sample record: N, strata, draws, failures, abandonments), amount-in-words or reason code, act ids. Byte-deterministic.
Draft/working BOQ (unpriced M3, priced M6) with a DRAFT — UNSIGNED banner where no signature exists; same layout family as A-BILL-PDF.

Workbook: Summary, Bill sheets by section (Item, Code, Description, Unit, Quantity, Rate, Amount with live formulas), Quantities (every line with bases, coverage, source sheet, formula string), Resources, Assumptions/Exclusions (from certificate); lakh/crore number formats; frozen headers.
Bar bending schedule by member and bar mark with shape sketches (Typst-drawn shape codes), cutting lengths, counts, weights, lap components; cutting-stock summary.
A sheet with measurement overlays and legend, vector where possible (SVG from the render manifest embedded in Typst), with sheet metadata footer.
Analysis of rates per item: resource lines, contributions, composite; edition and zone named.
Resource summary (material takeoff) by section and total.
Priced BOQ in the e-GP tender BOQ shape (Item No, Code, Description, Unit, Quantity, Unit Price figures, Unit Price words, Total).
The bid's priced BOQ for portal entry (CSV/XLSX + PDF).
Bid book: cover, submission summary, priced BOQ, rate summary, assumptions and exclusions, bracket analysis (with a clear internal/external flag — bracket analysis is internal by default).
Revision delta report (quantities and priced impact).
RICS pack (reliability decision, sample record, certificate, AI disclosure).
Documented JSON export of the register and lines (versioned schema in Zod, published in docs).

verification.principle: Only a tool result is evidence. A requirement is done when its evidence exists: a green lane, a passing journey with screenshots, a golden vector within band, a document that matches its golden, a visual baseline that matches, an axe report with zero serious findings, a performance budget met. The model's word, the builder's summary and a PR description are never evidence (B-10).

lanes.lane: `next typegen` → `tsc --noEmit` → `eslint .` (boundary rules, NEVERs, token/colour rule, string-table rule) → `vitest run` (unit, contract, golden formulas, refusal register, document payload schemas, EntityGraph mirror fixtures) → schema drift (`drizzle-kit generate` into scratch, tree untouched) → method-hash manifest → catalogue/bears table drift → `ruff check` + `pytest` (cad) → `next build` cold into its own distDir. Fail-fast; exit code is the whole contract; wall time printed.
Live Postgres seam tests: RLS per table, cross-tenant refusal, append-only grants, act-seam transactionality, composite FKs, migration ledger.

Builds once, seeds a scratch DB with the e2e fixture tenant/users/project, starts web (3211) + worker, runs Playwright journeys (J-nnn) with traces, screenshots at named checkpoints, video on failure, axe on every checkpoint page, and visual comparisons against committed Linux baselines (`toHaveScreenshot`, maxDiffPixelRatio 0.002, per-journey masks for volatile regions). Model calls use fixture transport. Runs in CI on every PR and by the harness gate.
Runs the engine over the fixture drawing sets and compares against hand takeoffs per (engine, class, kind) at ±3%/+0%; records validation observations; the over arm fails the build.

Renders every document kind from committed payloads; asserts byte-identity with golden PDFs (renderer pin), text extraction contains required strings, font coverage, and A-BILL-PDF's certificate rules (no cardinalities, both statements present, sort order).

lane.budget: ≤ 10 min, nightly and at milestone gates

lanes.lane: Playwright + Lighthouse-style timings for PB-1…PB-7 on the reference machine; a budget miss is a defect, not a baseline.
The machine's report: node/pnpm/uv/typst/libredwg pins and hashes, Postgres reachable, roles, ledger drift, ports bindable, storage root, env; runs at session start.

fixtures.fixture: A synthetic six-storey RCC residential building authored by `fixtures/gen/rcc6.py` (ezdxf): foundation plan (footings F1–F4, pile caps PC1–PC2, tie beams), typical floor plan (columns C1–C4 with grid A–F/1–6, beams B1–B6, slab, openings), roof plan, column schedule, beam schedule, footing schedule, sections with levels, general notes (fy, cover, laps `50d`), title blocks; exported as DXF, DWG (via LibreDWG round-trip in the generator), vector PDF (generated by a permissive vector writer in the fixtures generator — decision D-04) and raster PDF/PNG (rendered at 200 DPI with mild skew and noise); plus a hand takeoff workbook (JSON) with quantities per (class, kind, level) computed independently by formula from the authored inputs — the golden.
Revision pair: F-RCC6 with a re-origined typical plan, two columns resized, one beam added, one sheet re-authored, one sheet re-issued as a scan; expected deltas authored.
Architectural set: floor plans with rooms and labels, door/window schedules, finish schedule, wall types; hand takeoff for finishes and openings.
A plumbing/electrical plan with runs by size (lengths only).
Scanned sheets (raster) of F-RCC6 with a pasted detail; expected INTERPRETED sightings and corroboration flow.
A fictional two-page SoR chapter PDF with zone columns, one flagged row, one heading-hidden item, one added-rate item; expected load.
The digitised PWD SoR 2022 editions (platform data, generated by the pipeline with human QA — the QA record committed as data).
A tender BOQ (CSV + PDF) for a small works package with published OCE for one case.
Recorded model-call fixtures for every proposal the journeys exercise.
fixtures.rule: Fixtures are generated by committed scripts and checked in with their generator hash; competitor drawings never enter; the SAMPLE project shown to new users is F-RCC6 + F-ARCH.

journeys.journey: Sign up → create tenant → create project → upload F-RCC6 (DXF) → confirm disciplines → affirm scale → run partition → see column lines → view coverage grid → generate BOQ PDF (draft) → [M5] activate PWD book → [M6] create estimate, price, export → [M7] review, sample, sign, issue → [M8] tender, OCE, bracket, bid book → [M9] re-issue and delta. quality-bar.name: What production grade means, checkable
quality-bar.check: V-VERIFY green, ≤ 60 s local, no cache; every guardrail rule has a fixture test proving it fires.
V-E2E green for every journey of the current and previous milestones; J-000 always.
V-GOLDEN within band; over arm never trips.
Visual baselines match (or an approved baseline update with a recorded reason).
Refusal register: every code exercised by name or deferred by name; no orphan codes.

No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error`, no `eslint-disable`, no `.skip`/`.only`, no snapshot regeneration in a change without a recorded reason; test count and assertion count never decrease without a recorded reason (structural diff check).
Coverage of core and modules ≥ 85% lines (tripwire only, never a target to game).
Performance budgets PB-1…PB-7 met at each milestone gate.
axe: zero serious/critical on every journey checkpoint; keyboard journey J-004/J-011 pass.
Security: dependency audit clean of high/critical (or recorded exception), RLS proven, no secrets in repo, auth rate limits tested, uploads validated, signed URLs expire.
Docs: every module has an atlas page (purpose, seams, key files, how to run, how to test) regenerated at milestone end; every ADR-worthy decision recorded.
No TODO/FIXME/placeholder UI in shipped code; every screen's seven states implemented (R-UI-050).
Every `must` requirement of the milestone maps to at least one journey or lane assertion in the traceability matrix (`docs/traceability.json`, generated).

assumptions.assumption: The reference machine is WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 with native Postgres 16 on 5544; CI is ubuntu-latest with a Postgres service; performance budgets are measured on the reference machine and recorded with it.

Real PWD/LGED/RHD PDFs are public government publications and may be digitised as platform data; the QA record is committed; the unified national schedule, when published, loads as another book with zero code.
The vector-PDF fixture is generated inside `cad/` fixtures by a permissive vector writer (decision D-04); no AGPL library is used in generation either.
The vectoriser is classical CV (OpenCV, pinned) — deterministic; a learned vectoriser is a later decision under L-CAD-02.
Model ids used in production are `claude-opus-5` for reading/proposals and `claude-sonnet-5` for cheap classification; fixtures make verify network-free.

A "campaign" is one measurement effort against one pinned set revision producing at most one issued bill; an estimate references a campaign's published lines; a bid references an approved estimate version.
